# CalcBlueprint

> Free construction calculators for contractors, estimators, and DIY. Instant material estimates for concrete, roofing, flooring, paint, and more. No signup, no account, no ads before results.

CalcBlueprint is an independent tool site built by Emiliano. Every calculator uses published formulas from ACI 318, NRCA, IRC, TCNA, ASTM, and manufacturer specifications — not proprietary algorithms. Results are estimates for planning; verify with a licensed professional before ordering materials.

## Most Used Calculators

- [Concrete Slab Cost Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/concrete-slab-cost-calculator/): Concrete volume in cubic yards and total dollar cost for slabs, patios, and driveways.
- [Concrete Mix Ratio Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/concrete-mix-calculator/): Cement, sand, and aggregate ratios by PSI target (2500–4000 PSI).
- [Deck Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/deck-calculator/): Deck boards, joists, and post counts from deck length, width, and joist spacing.
- [Tile Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/tile-calculator/): Tile count, boxes, thinset bags, and grout pounds for any floor or wall.
- [Paint Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/paint-calculator/): Gallons of paint per coat for walls and ceilings by room dimensions.
- [Roof Area Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/roof-area-calculator/): True roof surface area from building footprint and pitch multiplier.
- [Gravel Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/gravel-calculator/): Gravel volume in cubic yards and tons by area, depth, and aggregate type.
- [Fence Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/fence-calculator/): Fence posts, rails, pickets, and concrete bags by linear footage and height.

## Concrete & Masonry

- [Concrete Footing Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/concrete-footing-calculator/): Cubic yards of concrete for continuous footings by width, depth, and total length.
- [Concrete Column Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/concrete-column-calculator/): Concrete for round, square, and rectangular columns and piers.
- [Concrete Steps Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/concrete-steps-calculator/): Concrete volume and bag count for straight-run outdoor steps and stoops.
- [Concrete Stairs Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/concrete-stairs-calculator/): Full staircases with structural thickness, landings, and rebar length.
- [Concrete Block Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/concrete-block-calculator/): CMU block count and mortar for walls and foundations.
- [Rebar Spacing Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/rebar-spacing-calculator/): Rebar grid layout, bar spacing, lap splices, and total linear feet.
- [How Many Bags of Concrete?](https://calcblueprint.com/how-many-bags-of-concrete/): Reference tables for 60 lb and 80 lb bag counts by slab size and post hole dimensions.
- [Brick Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/brick-calculator/): Bricks, mortar bags, and sand for walls, patios, and chimneys.
- [Mortar Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/mortar-calculator/): Mortar, sand, and cement for brick and block walls by joint width.

## Roofing & Gutters

- [Roof Pitch Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/roof-pitch-calculator/): Convert rise and run to pitch ratio (X:12), angle in degrees, and multiplier.
- [Shingle Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/shingle-calculator/): Bundles and squares of asphalt shingles from roof area and pitch.
- [Roof Truss Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/roof-truss-calculator/): Truss count, span, and spacing for house and garage roofs.
- [Ridge Vent Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/ridge-vent-calculator/): Ridge vent linear feet and net free vent area by attic floor area.
- [Gutter Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/gutter-calculator/): Gutters, downspouts, and hangers by roof area and pitch.

## Stairs & Framing

- [Stair Stringer Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/stair-stringer-calculator/): Stringer length, stair angle, notch layout, board size, and stringer count by rise and run.
- [Board Foot Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/board-foot-calculator/): Board feet and total cost from thickness, width, length, and quantity.
- [Wall Area Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/wall-area-calculator/): Net wall square footage after subtracting doors and windows.

## Flooring & Tile

- [Hardwood Flooring Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/hardwood-flooring-calculator/): Hardwood planks and cartons by room dimensions and plank size.
- [Laminate Flooring Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/laminate-flooring-calculator/): Laminate planks, cartons, and waste allowance.
- [Carpet Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/carpet-calculator/): Carpet square yards and padding with seam and directional layout allowances.
- [Kitchen Floor Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/kitchen-floor-calculator/): Tile, laminate, or vinyl quantities for kitchen floors.
- [Bathroom Floor Tile Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/bathroom-floor-tile-calculator/): Bathroom floor tile count, thinset, and grout.
- [Shower Tile Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/shower-tile-calculator/): Tile, thinset, and grout for shower walls and pans.
- [Backsplash Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/backsplash-calculator/): Kitchen and bathroom backsplash tile with outlet deductions.
- [Thinset Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/thinset-calculator/): Mortar bags by trowel notch size and tile format.
- [Grout Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/grout-calculator/): Grout pounds and bags by tile size, joint width, and total area.

## Walls, Ceilings & Finishes

- [Drywall Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/drywall-calculator/): Drywall sheets, screws, and joint compound by room dimensions and ceiling height.
- [Drywall Mud Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/drywall-mud-calculator/): Joint compound quantity by sheet count, joint length, and finish level.
- [Drywall Screws Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/drywall-screws-calculator/): Screw count by sheet count, stud spacing, and stud length.
- [Corner Bead Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/corner-bead-calculator/): Linear feet and box quantity of corner bead for outside corners.
- [Wallpaper Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/wallpaper-calculator/): Wallpaper rolls by wall dimensions, roll size, and pattern repeat.
- [Insulation Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/insulation-calculator/): Batts, rolls, or blown-in bags by R-value target and insulation type.

## Siding & Exterior

- [Vinyl Siding Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/vinyl-siding-calculator/): Vinyl siding squares, trim, and accessories by wall area.
- [Hardie Plank Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/hardie-plank-calculator/): Fiber cement siding boards by wall area, board dimensions, and overlap.

## Fencing & Gates

- [Chain Link Fence Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/chain-link-fence-calculator/): Chain link rolls, posts, rails, and tension wire by linear feet and height.
- [Privacy Fence Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/privacy-fence-calculator/): Privacy fence lumber, posts, rails, and concrete by height and picket spacing.
- [Gate Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/gate-calculator/): Gate lumber, hardware, and post sizing by gate width and height.

## Paving & Landscaping

- [Asphalt Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/asphalt-calculator/): Tons of hot mix asphalt by area, thickness, and compaction density.
- [Paver Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/paver-calculator/): Paver count, base gravel, and joint sand for driveways and patios.
- [Retaining Wall Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/retaining-wall-calculator/): Retaining wall blocks, capstones, and drainage gravel by wall length and height.
- [Mulch Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/mulch-calculator/): Mulch cubic yards, cubic feet, and bag counts by bed area and depth.
- [Topsoil Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/topsoil-calculator/): Topsoil volume by area and depth with compaction allowance.
- [Compost Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/compost-calculator/): Compost volume for beds, gardens, and raised beds.
- [Sod Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/sod-calculator/): Sod rolls and pallets by lawn square footage.
- [Grass Seed Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/grass-seed-calculator/): Grass seed pounds by lawn area, grass type, and seeding rate.
- [Fertilizer Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/fertilizer-calculator/): Fertilizer pounds and bags by lawn area and N-P-K ratio.
- [Artificial Turf Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/artificial-turf-calculator/): Turf rolls and square footage with seam allowances.

## HVAC

- [AC Unit Size Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/ac-unit-size-calculator/): Cooling capacity in tons by square footage, ceiling height, and climate zone.
- [BTU Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/btu-calculator/): BTU cooling and heating load by room size, windows, and occupancy.
- [Furnace Size Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/furnace-size-calculator/): Furnace BTU capacity by square footage, climate zone, and insulation level.
- [Duct Size Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/duct-size-calculator/): Round and rectangular duct dimensions by CFM, duct type, and run length.

## Electrical

- [Electrical Load Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/electrical-load-calculator/): Service panel amperage by appliance load, square footage, and voltage.
- [Wire Size Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/wire-size-calculator/): AWG wire gauge by amp load, run length, and voltage drop limit.
- [Breaker Size Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/breaker-size-calculator/): Breaker amperage and wire gauge by circuit load and voltage.
- [Outlet Spacing Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/outlet-spacing-calculator/): Outlet count and placement by wall length and local code spacing.

## Notes

- All calculators are free and require no signup or account.
- Formula sources: ACI 318 (concrete), NRCA (roofing), IRC and ICC (framing and stairs), TCNA (tile), ASTM (materials), AWC NDS (lumber).
- Results are planning estimates. Verify with a licensed professional before ordering materials or beginning structural work.
- Contact: hello@calcblueprint.com
